title: Demo report download builds a URL that 404s — analysis_id prefix stripped one char too many
evidence:
demo_api.gleam:521  let application_id = string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)
demo_api.gleam:528  let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"
demo_store.gleam:197  analysis id is "an-aoife"; demo_store.gleam:1425 report_filenames key is #("a-aoife", ...). On disk: server/priv/static/demo/ contains report-a-aoife.pdf (ls shows report-a-aoife.pdf, report-a-conor.pdf, ... report-a-tom.pdf). drop_start("an-aoife", 3) yields "aoife", not "a-aoife".
detail: drop_start(3) on "an-aoife" produces "aoife", so the fetch hits /static/demo/report-aoife.pdf which does not exist (files are report-a-aoife.pdf). The filename lookup keyed on "a-aoife" also never matches. Every demo report download 404s and surfaces the error toast — the flagship demo moment is broken and no client test exercises the path.
recommended_fix: Derive the application id as "a-" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3) (or replace the "an-" prefix), so URL and report_filenames key resolve to report-a-aoife.pdf; add a demo_flow test asserting the download resolves Ok.

title: UserConfirmedApproval refetches the leaderboard from the stale (pre-mutation) demo store
detail: demo_status puts the mutated store in `updated.demo_store`, but the refetch reads `store_of(model)` — the old store — so the leaderboard (and the sweep-nudge predicate the real handler's refetch exists to serve, per client.gleam:2614-2618) deterministically renders the pre-approval state, diverging from the live flow.
recommended_fix: Use store_of(updated) for the leaderboard refetch so it resolves from the post-approval store.

title: Six pub refcheck mirror functions in demo_api are never called — demo_update dispatches through the generic refcheck_action
evidence: demo_api.gleam pub fns: start_check (332), skip_reference (343), re_enable_reference (354), take_over_reference (372), correct_reference (390), substitute_reference (411). grep across client/src shows the only external caller is demo_update.gleam:541: demo_api.refcheck_action(store, vid, aid, call_id, action, fn(result) { ... }) — none of the six named mirrors is referenced.
detail: ~130 lines of unused public mirror API (plus the private refcheck helper that exists only to serve them) can drift silently from reference_checks_api; being pub they draw no unused-function warning. The generic refcheck_action already covers every action string the demo fires.
recommended_fix: Delete the six unused named wrappers and the private refcheck helper (or drop refcheck_action and route demo_update through the named mirrors) — keep exactly one shape.

title: demo_store.gleam is 1478 lines, mixing ~700 lines of per-applicant craft literals with the store/derivation logic
evidence: wc -l: 1478 client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam (vs 204 for demo_fixtures.gleam). analysis_for / audit_for / documents_for / reference_calls_for / co_applicants_for span lines ~183-625 as inline case literals; derivation + mutations follow. AGENTS.md: "Target: <200 lines for logic modules".
detail: The store is both the fixture content (the marketing craft) and the state/derivation engine, making the module 7x the project size target and burying the mutation logic between craft tables. Splitting craft into the fixtures module would keep demo_store a readable logic module.
recommended_fix: Move the per-application craft constructors (analysis_for, audit_for, documents_for, reference_calls_for, etc.) into demo_fixtures.gleam (or a demo/craft module), leaving demo_store.gleam with types, seeding, derivation and mutations.
